  NOTE     Both Alice and Zhuzhen must be in your active party.
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Make your way to the Nemeton Monastery and head up the hill toward JamesO'Flaherty's grave. As you approach it, you'll watch a long scene between Alice
and Yuri as Zhuzhen checks out the grave, and eventually brings you the
[_BOOK OF RITUALS_]. Examine the Book of Rituals in your Valuables menu, and
it'll unlock the Ancient Ruins on your World Map the next time you're there.

  NOTE     You can put whomever you want back into your party now.
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Make your way back into the Underground Ruins of the Nemeton Monastery, and
follow the path as it goes all the way west, then down when you can't go west
anymore and head all the way east until you can follow the path back to the
shrine where you fought Amon. If you check the ground here in the center of the
Judgment Ring near the altar, you will find the [_CODEX OF LURIE_].

That's it for here. On to the next quest!
